As in correlation maximization, the classes S, B ⊆ ([−1, 1] ∪ {∗})X can contain any partial real-valued hypotheses h : X → [−1, 1] ∪ {∗}, and we assume that the data distribution µ satisfies E(x,y)∼µ [y|x] = s(x) for a source hypothesis s ∈ S. Also, the sample complexity is polynomial in 1/ε if and only if fatη (S, B) is polynomial in 1/η. This answers an open question in [48].
